coverage: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30) · Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30) · Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)

sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x vests, 2x radios, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/videos provided at the end of the shift report.
McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store checked. All clear. Proceeded towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Sweep commenced.
Aotea Square checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Auckland Library and Lorne Street checked. All clear. Proceeded towards Elliott Street and Darby Street.
Elliott Street and Darby Street checked. All clear. Proceeded up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Wellesley Street checked. All clear. Proceeded through Federal Street.
Welfare checks at Eighty Fed, both 77 Convenience Stores, Coffee Club, and News Agency Store. All clear. Presence maintained.
Proceeded towards Wyndham Street via Federal Street.
Federal Street checked. All clear. Welfare checks commenced around the Cathedral.
Cathedral checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Welfare checks at Hollywood Cafe, Coffee Club, and Chemist Warehouse. All clear. Proceeded through Vulcan Lane towards High Street.
Vulcan Lane checked. All clear. Proceeded towards O'Connell Street.
O'Connell Street checked. All clear. Proceeded to Chancery Square.
Chancery Square checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Proceeded towards headquarters via High Street.
Arrived at headquarters for B Team. High Street checked. All clear. One guard remained on site charging the Ops phone.
No sign of the second B Team guard. Stood by awaiting management instruction.
Management advised they were looking for replacement guards. Patrolled within the headquarters area in case the second B Team guard arrived.
Management advised three guards would be deployed instead of four. Patrol recommenced.
Proceeded down Queen Street towards Britomart.
Business welfare checks completed from Farmers through to Q Convenience. All clear. Proceeded to Britomart.
McDonald's Britomart checked. All clear. Proceeded to Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay checked. All clear. Presence maintained.
Custom Mart and St Pierre's Sushi checked. All clear. Proceeded towards Gore Street.
Gore Street checked, including Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, Chargrill, and Noodle House. All clear. Presence maintained.
Fort Street, Wilson Carpark, 77 Convenience Store, Jo & Joe, Vape Haven, Right Track, Vapor Kings, KFC, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, and Snickel Lane checked. All clear. Continued towards Albert Street.
Lower Albert Woolworths, Aotea Gifts, and Albert Mart checked. All clear. Continued along Albert Street.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham Street and Albert Street and were approached by members of the public reporting a heated argument at a vagrant encampment. Guards proceeded to attend.
Arrived at the encampment. Occupants had left prior to guard arrival. Presence maintained.
Call received from Woolworths Victoria Street requesting assistance with moving along a vagrant.
Guards spoke with security, who advised a female shopper had complained about a vagrant due to smell and sleeping near the store entry.
Guards spoke with the vagrant and reached an agreement after an extensive discussion (video on file). Presence maintained.
Call received from Red Radisson regarding a male showing suspicious behaviour.
Guards received a photo of the suspicious male (photo on file). Presence maintained.
Proceeded to the office for break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x body cameras, 2x swipe cards, 2x vests, 1x Ops phone. All photos/videos provided at the end of the shift report.
Queen Street sweep completed. Welfare checks on stores completed. All clear. Proceeded towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Full sweep commenced and welfare check completed at McDonald's Britomart. All clear. Proceeded towards Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay and Lower Albert Street completed. No issues. Proceeded to Victoria Street.
Full sweep of Albert Street and Victoria Street completed. Welfare checks on stores completed. All clear. Proceeded towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Full sweep completed. All clear. Presence maintained along Queen Street while standing by for response calls.
Returned to headquarters to charge the Ops phone due to low battery.
Response call received from Cotton On regarding theft from store.
Vagrant stopped and merchandise returned to the store. No further issues. Description: all black clothing and holding a Woolworths bag.
Ops phone still low, but presence maintained along Queen Street.
Response call received from Starbucks requesting assistance to move a vagrant from the venue.
Vagrant moved from the venue. No further issues.
Vagrant treated as a POI and monitored. Presence maintained on Queen Street.
Vagrant observed consuming alcohol in public. When asked to move along, the vagrant refused and continued disturbing the peace.
Guards managed to get the vagrant onto a bus and leave the area. No further issues. Ops phone at 3%, returned to headquarters.
Stood by for response calls while Ops phone charged.
Proceeded to AKA Red Radisson for a welfare check.
Welfare check completed at AKA Red Radisson. No issues. Returned to headquarters to meet with management.
Patrol recommenced towards High Street and Chancery Square.
Full welfare check completed on High Street and Chancery Square. No issues. Proceeded towards Gore Street.
Welfare sweep along Fort Street completed. No issues. Proceeded towards Gore Street.
Presence maintained at Auckland Harbour Suites.
Stood down from Auckland Harbour Suites and returned to headquarters to meet with management.
Stood by near headquarters for response calls.
Response call received from Backpackers Albert Street requesting assistance to move an aggressive vagrant from the premises.
Backpackers advised assistance was no longer required as the vagrant had already left. Guards attended for a welfare check.

Welfare check completed at Backpackers. WhatsApp number provided so staff could send footage of the POI. Staff also requested the POI be trespassed from the premises. Guards kept watch. POI last seen wearing a cream jumper, grey shorts, green hat, and with tattoos on his face. Patrol resumed.
Possible break-in discovered at Pita Pit Cafe on Wyndham Street, with the door damaged. Management contacted. Guards stood by awaiting further instructions. (photos on file)
Incident reported to 105. Police to contact if further information is required.
Security presence maintained at Ace Nightclub until second guard arrived.
Afternoon shift completed. No further issues. Guards returned to headquarters.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift arrived on site and awaited afternoon shift debrief.

Afternoon shift guard completed Auror updates and handed over the Ops phone. The guard took an access card to drop off uniform to a coworker and returned with protective gear. Night shift stood by until the guard returned.
McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store checked. All clear. Proceeded towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Sweep commenced.

Debrief completed. Night shift advised of three key matters: Ace Karaoke staff believed gang members may have been at the venue and may call if an incident arises; Pita Pit on Wyndham Street had a failed attempted break-in and required regular checks; Backpackers on the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street may call regarding a trespassed female and request a formal verbal trespass.
Aotea Square checked. All clear. Proceeded towards Lorne Street.
Auckland Library and Lorne Street checked. All clear. Proceeded to the office to commence floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Quick welfare checks on businesses commenced.
McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store checked. All clear.
Elliott Street and Darby Street checked. All clear. Returned to headquarters to charge the Ops phone.
Ops phone placed on charge at 9%. (photo on file)
Call received from McDonald's Queen Street. Guards proceeded to assist.
Guards spoke with the manager. POI had been trespassed and was causing trouble with a tourist. (video on file)
Call received from Ace Karaoke security requesting assistance.

Arrived at Ace Karaoke. A male was being a nuisance towards guards, and a large group inside one of the rooms claimed to be part of an MC gang. Guards maintained presence after the group left aggressively due to the amount owed for the room and their attempt to take alcohol out of the venue.
Proceeded back towards Lower Albert Street.
Commercial Bay patrol commenced. Full sweep underway.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Fort Street and Wilson Carpark completed. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street completed. All clear, no issues.
Corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street checked. All clear, no issues.
Aotea Square checked. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep of St Patrick's Square completed. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street completed. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Durham Street completed. All clear, no issues.
McDonald's Queen Street checked. No issues. Returned to headquarters to charge the Ops phone (15%) while on standby for response calls.
30-minute break commenced while Ops phone continued charging.
Corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street checked. No issues.
Freyberg Square and Chancery Square checked. No issues. Returned to headquarters awaiting changeover.
